'''Messtin''' was a name used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hawra]] at the [[Lotide]] [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] in an attempt to trip up a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spies infiltrating the base. He claimed Messtin was his brother and served as assistant security chief at [[Dakot Tech]] on the planet [[Dakot Seven]].<ref name="BI" />
